title: bh-molecule: BH A–X band spectrum model and fitting tools
description:
This release archives the software version used for the revised BH A–X rotational-temperature analysis of the LHD study (the revision of the paper).

  • Models BH A¹Π–X¹Σ⁺ band spectra and fits measured spectra for rotational temperature.
  • Provides single-spectrum and batch workflows, configurable fit constraints, instrumental-width calibration, and tabular and graphical outputs.
  • New since v0.1.2: BHModel keyword switches whose defaults keep the v0.1.2 model bit-identical. The revised analysis (set C) is BHModel(upper_energies="fernando_bernath", v_max=0, baseline="linear", h2_lines=True): Fernando–Bernath f-level energies, the (0–0) band only, a linear continuum and the two H₂ lines of the fit window as free features, fitted over 433.05–433.80 nm (run_bh_batch(bh_fit_range=(433.05, 433.80), model_options={...})).
  • Sensitivity switches used in the revision’s checks: h2_r01_ratio (H₂ R0/R1 tied to R2), isotopologue="natural" with bh10_positions (10BH), extra_lines=("F1", "F3"), baseline="quadratic", rot_components=2, r11_lines="tied", stretch=True, baseline="hgamma" and baseline="fixed" with BHFitter(continuum=...), plus h2_lines="R2" and BHFitter(exclude_nm=...).
  • BHFitter carries a model’s extra and fixed parameters, run_bh_batch takes model_options and save_grid, set_bounds works with a fixed w_inst; the switches are documented in docs/phys.md.

Validation for this release: 155 tests passed, 1 skipped; the documentation built successfully in strict mode.
